description: Sliding Window Attention (SWA) single-chip inference, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1. Companion to Suite A — isolates the effect of SWA architecture (sliding_window=4096) vs full attention on the roofline intensity spectrum. Mistral-7B shares the same structural parameters as Llama-3-8B (32 layers, 32 heads, 8 KV heads, 4096 hidden) — the only architectural variable is the attention mechanism. Chosen over newer SWA models (Gemma 4, etc.) because the standard Mistral architecture ensures cross-platform compatibility (V100, T4, Ascend, TPU, AMD). All operating points match Suite A so architecture is the sole variable.
_model_revision_note: Pinned to the canonical v0.1 instruct checkpoint. This is the reference SWA implementation — the first production LLM to use sliding window attention with GQA.
_architecture_note: Mistral-7B-v0.1 uses pure Sliding Window Attention (w=4096) on ALL layers (no hybrid pattern like Gemma 3/4's 5:1 interleaving). This makes it a cleaner SWA signal than hybrid models — the entire attention mechanism is SWA, with no full-attention layers to confound the measurement. KV-cache size at context length L is bounded by O(window × layers) rather than O(L × layers), which directly shifts the model's position on the roofline curve.
_speculative_note: Suite H does not configure speculative decoding. Mistral-7B has no official draft model in the EAGLE family. Omitted from extra scenarios.
_max_model_len_note: Matches Suite A for apples-to-apples architecture comparison. Mistral-7B's SWA (w=4096) means at 4096 context, each token attends to all previous tokens (window ≥ context) — the SWA effect on compute is neutral here. The architectural difference manifests in KV-cache memory pressure and the intensity profile when concurrency scales up (more KV caches = more memory bandwidth pressure, which SWA mitigates).
_concurrency_levels_note: Matches Suite A. Mistral-7B (~14 GB BF16) leaves ~66 GB for KV cache on an 80 GB GPU. At 4096 context, SWA caps per-request KV cache at window_size=4096 (same as full attention at this context length), so the memory profile is similar. The SWA advantage shows at higher context lengths and batch sizes where full-attention KV cache would OOM.
_accuracy_note: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 scores ~60% on MMLU (vs Llama-3-8B ~65%). The 0.1 delta threshold is adequate for detecting broken precision/quantization. Baseline score must be established on first successful BF16 run.
_request_count_note: offline uses request_count (100), online uses online_request_count (300, minimum for robust p99), interactive uses interactive_request_count (150, minimum for robust p95)
